Markets.title: Global Market: China stocks rebound, but weekly loss looms as AI rally cools
Markets.summary: Chinese mainland stocks and Hong Kong's Hang Seng rose on Friday, recovering some ground led by technology shares. However, major benchmarks remained on track for weekly losses due to fading momentum in artificial intelligence stocks and elevated US Treasury yields.

Markets.title: India bonds pause before weekly debt supply
Markets.summary: Indian government bond yields remained steady on Friday morning as traders awaited an upcoming debt sale to gauge market demand. Meanwhile, stable oil prices and U.S. Treasury yields influenced local markets, even as global risks and inflation concerns persisted.

Markets.title: Global Market: JGB yields extend fall as stronger yen, hawkish BOJ outlook lift sentiment
Markets.summary: Japanese government bond yields fell further on Friday, with the 10-year yield dropping 5.5 basis points to 2.91%. This decline was driven by a stronger yen, expectations of a hawkish Bank of Japan, and shifting U.S. rate expectations.

Markets.title: Global Market: Japan stocks rebound on Wall Street boost, SoftBank rally
Markets.summary: Japan's Nikkei index rebounded on Friday, ending a four-session losing streak due to gains on Wall Street and a rally in SoftBank Group. Despite the daily gain, the index is still heading for its third consecutive weekly decline driven by expectations of further Bank of Japan rate hikes.

Markets.title: IFCI shares rally 6% as NSE IPO buzz lifts sentiment; stock gains 35% in a month
Markets.summary: IFCI shares rallied over 6% due to renewed optimism surrounding the long-awaited NSE initial public offering. The state-owned financial services company indirectly holds more than a 4% stake in the NSE through SHCIL.

Markets.title: Robinhood stock surges: Why HOOD is rallying and what Wall Street sees next
Markets.summary: Robinhood stock surged after analysts raised their price targets due to growth in prediction markets, cryptocurrency, and business diversification. While upcoming sports-event trading could drive further growth, investors remain concerned about the company's elevated valuation and volatility.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal says it will need billions in funding to rebuild after flash floods
Geo-Political.summary: Nepal authorities are beginning to clear debris and assess damage following recent flash floods. Officials state that the country will require billions of dollars in funding to rebuild.

Geo-Political.title: Tensions flare as judge declines to remove juror in Lindsay Clancy trial
Geo-Political.summary: The defense lawyer expressed frustration after the judge refused to remove a holdout juror in the Lindsay Clancy triple murder trial. This decision caused tensions to rise in the courtroom regarding the composition of the jury.

Geo-Political.title: Argentine leader threatens to sanction oil firms and reiterates Falklands claim
Geo-Political.summary: Argentine President Javier Milei has threatened to sanction oil companies operating near the Falkland Islands. He also reiterated Argentina's territorial claim to the British overseas territory.

Geo-Political.title: US investigating if missile hit Iran wedding, Vance says
Geo-Political.summary: The US is investigating whether a missile struck an Iranian wedding ceremony on Tuesday. The Iranian Red Crescent Society reported that the resulting shrapnel killed four people.

Geo-Political.title: Steve Irwin's family celebrates 'superhero' dad, 20 years after shock death
Geo-Political.summary: The family of Australian television personality Steve Irwin is commemorating him twenty years after his death. Irwin was killed in 2006 when a stingray's barb pierced his chest while he was filming.

Geo-Political.title: Transplanted pig kidney works in US man's body for record 271 days
Geo-Political.summary: A US man lived for a record 271 days with a transplanted pig kidney while waiting for a human organ. This achievement marks the longest a gene-edited animal kidney has functioned inside a human body.

Data & Insights.summary: Congress leader Shashi Tharoor urged the Modi government to directly respond to a critique regarding India's GDP data. Tharoor warned that failing to address these criticisms would harm the government's credibility.

Data & Insights.summary: Uttar Pradesh Finance Minister Suresh Khanna stated that the state will balance a major infrastructure and technology investment push with strict fiscal discipline. The government plans to keep its fiscal deficit under 3% of the Gross State Domestic Product.

Data & Insights.title: Fed's Waller signals patience on rates, but keeps hike on table if inflation heats up
Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller stated he is in no rush to change interest rates while monitoring upcoming inflation data. However, he remains open to a potential rate hike if progress toward the 2% inflation goal stalls.

Data & Insights.summary: The Congress party has questioned the government's reported 7.8% GDP growth figure and its chest-thumping claims. It demanded an explanation regarding the methodology used and the reasoning behind a ₹43 lakh crore reduction in the estimated size of the economy.

Data & Insights.title: Raghuram Rajan clarifies his stand on GDP: If growth is strong, why aren’t private investment, FDI and jobs rising?
Data & Insights.summary: Former RBI Governor Raghuram Rajan stated he has neither questioned nor endorsed India's official GDP growth figures. However, he expressed confusion over why this reported growth has not led to increased private investment, foreign direct investment, or job creation.
